decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template was publicly recommended at launch and fits the firm's shop-hosting core, so it costs little to maintain and dropping it now would contradict that endorsement.
This template sits close to the hosting offer and needs little upkeep, but it was only mentioned in passing, so the firm has limited public commitment to justify keeping it.
Premium support is central to the firm's announced agency-focused, round-the-clock service promise, so withdrawing it would undercut that direction and write off the investment.
The version management tool reflects the firm's own development investment, has a dedicated page, and matches its strategy of tools that reduce recurring work, so commitment is strong.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the core business, but it has its own page and serves GDPR needs that are still current in 2019, so weak results can still be blamed on temporary causes and it is kept for now.
